notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39925719/7ff10bdc6a66c42e8da756858c0717ec4e2ffe48.png[/img]

[h1]Starlight Shores is coming to Steam on May 7th, 2021![/h1]

The Delphinium Interactive team is incredibly excited to see Starlight Shores launch on Steam. 

It will differ slightly from the current version available on itchio, as we'll be launching Version 1.3 on May 7th to coincide with our Steam release.

This update will include a handful of new CGs, background art, and quality of life updates to ensure the smoothest launch possible.

[b]Please note that while unlocked gallery items will remain consistent between platforms, players should never try to access itch files via Steam, or vice versa. Demo files are also incompatible.[/b]

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out!

[b]-The Delphinium Interactive Team[/b]
